subject: Data Engineering
title: OLAP Cubes
description: A fast breakdown of OLAP Cubes for builders.

hook.text: Imagine slicing data by time, region, and product simultaneously — like rotating a 3D cube of data.

buildup.text: OLAP cubes pre-compute aggregations across multiple dimensions so drill-downs are instant.

discovery.text: Slice shows one dimension. Dice shows a subcube. Drill-down goes from year to quarter to month.

twist.text: Cubes were essential when hardware was slow. Modern warehouses can compute on the fly just as fast.

climax.text: OLAP cubes taught us how to think about multi-dimensional analysis, even if the tech has moved on.

punchline.text: The cube is dead. Its ideas live on in every dashboard.
